correctness.rationale: For the stated complete-reset planar active Brownian SDE, the heading first harmonic is exp(-gamma t), and integrating the linear mean equation gives F. Absolute cycle rewards have finite expectation under every positive finite-mean iid clock. The renewal-reward identity, unique sign change of F prime, unique positive root of tF-G, exact concave majorant, Jensen equality classification, and approximating two-atom sequence prove every quantifier in the claim. The Poisson formula is recovered exactly by integration. The standalone checker passed 2390 independent finite/symbolic diagnostics; no finite experiment is used as a universal proof.

The sharp two-branch equal-mean clock frontier and its equality/nonattainment classification were not found to be stated or implied by the material inspected. value.rationale: Optimizing steady mean alignment is already an explicit physical objective in the motivating 2024 paper. Requiring a fixed average reset rate is a natural resource constraint. The result classifies the entire admissible clock space rather than optimizing a narrow parametric family, resolves the nonattainment/bursting boundary, proves deterministic optimality beyond a sharp threshold, and gives an explicit 19.37 percent gain over the best Poisson clock in the matched-timescale case.
